title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
reason: CFTC chairman clarifies regulatory path for onchain derivatives, a significant compliance milestone for major platforms.

sources.summary: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
reason: Protocol upgrade delay to 2027 is a major infrastructure change affecting Ethereum's roadmap and developer expectations.

sources.summary: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.
